# What sensor blocks do
Sensor blocks are light blue. They are round reporter blocks that give you a value, so you drop them inside other blocks such as if, display text or send data.

# distance
Gives the distance to the nearest object in centimetres. Needs the distance sensor on the Robotics kit.

# line sensor sees line
Gives true when the sensor is over the black line and false when it is over white paper.

# temperature value
Gives the temperature in degrees Celsius from the IoT kit temperature sensor.

# light level
Gives a number from 0 for dark to 100 for very bright. Use it for the Smart Night Light.

# motion detected
Gives true when the motion sensor sees something moving in front of it.

# Choosing the port
Each sensor block has a port number. It must match the port where you plugged the sensor in, otherwise the value never changes.
